context: A teacher discusses a research paper
purpose: Teach: 北陸/音波/雑草/食用/耐性/重心/史実/過熱

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、北陸地方の水産業、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on Hokuriku fisheries was really thoughtful.
lines.style: Warm approval, measured pace. Genuine recognition — not performative. Slight pause before the compliment lands, like she's noticed something worth saying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海洋音波の調査も、章として入れました。
lines.en: Yes. I included marine-sonar surveys as their own chapter.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the work, but careful not to oversell it. Steady rhythm. Respectful eye contact — responding to her attention, not seeking praise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 湿地帯の雑草の生態、生物多様性に資する研究ですね。
lines.en: The wetland-weed ecology — that's research that really serves biodiversity.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Genuine interest, not small talk. Clear articulation of why this matters. A teacher noticing something that connected.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 食用と非食用、品種ごとに整理しました。
lines.en: I organized the food and non-food varieties by species throughout.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Pride in the rigor, but understated. Slight hesitation — testing whether she's following, whether it's organized enough.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 環境変化への耐性、品種ごとに差がありますね。
lines.en: Climate resilience does vary significantly by species, doesn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly contemplative tone. Not quite a question, but leaving space for him to respond. Recognition of a crucial detail he's uncovered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 重心となる仮説、論文の核です。
lines.en: That's really the heart of the entire argument.
lines.style: Earnest, no hedging. Quiet conviction. He's identified something true and he knows it. Slight emphasis on 「核」— this is load-bearing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 史実との対比、近世史で扱われた章もありますね。
lines.en: And you've even included a chapter comparing it against the historical record — early modern sources too.
lines.style: Appreciative recognition. Slight lift of surprise — he went further than expected. Teacher-to-student moment of noticing real intellectual work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議論の過熱を避けつつ、慎重に進めました。
lines.en: I was careful to develop the argument rigorously without getting caught up in the politics of it.
lines.style: Calm, measured. Self-aware about the sensitivity. No defensiveness, just clarity. The discipline of knowing when to hold the line and when to step back.
